speaker: Odessa Clay
text: Cassius Jr.'s life to me was an unusual one from other Children, and he is still Unusual to day
source_title: Growing Up Scared in Louisville, Jack Olsen, Sports Illustrated, April 18, 1966
context: Quoted from a handwritten biographical sketch of her son she gave the reporter in 1966, when he was heavyweight champion. Original spelling kept.
source_type: Her own handwritten sketch, as published in a contemporaneous magazine article
also_spoken_1966: Oh, he was a unusual child all his life. So if people will read his early life they'll understand why he is like he is, I guess. (same article, page 1)
